svg.desc: Two rising, connected lowercase b modules. Original vector logo for BBuidl AI Lab, BBuidl.xyz. Option 02.

path.aria-label: A modular identity. Built to move forward.
TWO b MODULES / ONE CONTINUOUS STRUCTURE
A shared edge. An upward rhythm.
No gradients. No effects. Just structure.
A 45-degree cut gives both modules the same visual language.
